verses.en: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
verses.pt: Benjamim foi pai de Belá, seu primogênito, de Asbel o segundo, e de Aará o terceiro,
verses.en_web: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
verses.en_bbe: And Benjamin was the father of Bela his oldest son, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

verses.en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.pt: de Noá o quarto, e de Rafa o quinto.
verses.en_web: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.en_bbe: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

verses.en: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
verses.pt: Belá teve estes filhos: Adar, Gêra, Abiúde,
verses.en_web: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
verses.en_bbe: And Bela had sons, Addar and Gera, the father of Ehud,

verses.en: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
verses.pt: Abisua, Naamã, Aoá,
verses.en_web: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
verses.en_bbe: And Abishua and Naaman and Ahoah

verses.en: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.pt: Gêra, Sefufã e Hurão.
verses.en_web: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.en_bbe: And Gera and Shephuphan and Huram.

verses.en: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
verses.pt: Estes foram os filhos de Eúde, que foram os chefes das casas paternas dos habitantes de Geba, e que foram levados cativos para Manaate;
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:
verses.en_bbe: And these are the sons of Ehud, heads of families of those living in Geba: Iglaam and Alemeth

verses.en: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
verses.pt: Naamã, Aías e Gêra; este os transportou; foi ele pai de Uzá e Aiúde.
verses.en_web: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
verses.en_bbe: And Naaman and Ahijah and Gera; and Iglaam was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

verses.en: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
verses.pt: Saaraim teve filhos na terra de Moabe, depois que despedira Husim e Baara, suas mulheres.
verses.en_web: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.
verses.en_bbe: And Shaharaim became the father of children in the country of the Moabites after driving out Hushim and Beerah his wives;

verses.en: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
verses.pt: E de Hodes, sua mulher, teve Jobabe, Zíbia, Messa, Malcã,
verses.en_web: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
verses.en_bbe: And by Hodesh his wife he became the father of Jobab and Zibia and Mesha and Malcam.

verses.en: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
verses.pt: Jeuz, Saquias e Mirma; esses foram seus filhos:, chefes de casas paternas:
verses.en_web: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.
verses.en_bbe: And Jeuz and Shachia and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.

verses.en: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
verses.pt: De Husim teve Abitube e Elpaal.
verses.en_web: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.
verses.en_bbe: And Hushim became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

verses.en: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
verses.pt: Os filhos de Elpaal: Eber, Misã, Semede (este edificou Ono e Lode e suas aldeias),
verses.en_web: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber and Misham and Shemed (he was the builder of Ono and Lod and their daughter-towns);

verses.en: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
verses.pt: Berias e Sema (estes foram chefes de casas paternas dos habitantes de Aijalom, os quais afugentaram os habitantes de Gatel ,
verses.en_web: and Beriah, and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;
verses.en_bbe: And Beriah and Shema, who were heads of the families of those who were living in Aijalon, who put to flight the people living in Gath;

verses.en: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
verses.pt: Aiô, Sasaque e Jerimote.
verses.en_web: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
verses.en_bbe: And their brothers Shashak and Jeremoth.

verses.en: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
verses.pt: Zebadias, Arade, Eder,
verses.en_web: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
verses.en_bbe: And Zebadiah and Arad and Eder

verses.en: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
verses.pt: Micael, Ispá e Joá foram filhos de Berias;
verses.en_web: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,
verses.en_bbe: And Michael and Ishpah and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

verses.en: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
verses.pt: Zebadias, Mesulão, Hizqui, Heber,
verses.en_web: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
verses.en_bbe: And Zebadiah and Meshullam and Hizki and Heber

verses.en: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
verses.pt: Ismerai, Izlias e Jobabe foram filhos de Elpaal;
verses.en_web: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,
verses.en_bbe: And Ishmerai and Izliah and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

verses.en: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
verses.pt: Jaquim, Zicri, Zabdi,
verses.en_web: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,
verses.en_bbe: And Jakim and Zichri and Zabdi

verses.en: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
verses.pt: Elienai, Ziletai, Eliel,
verses.en_web: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
verses.en_bbe: And Elienai and Zillethai and Eliel

verses.en: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
verses.pt: Adaías, Beraías e Sinrate foram filhos de Simei;
verses.en_web: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,
verses.en_bbe: And Adaiah and Beraiah and Shimrath, the sons of Shimei;

verses.en: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
verses.pt: Ispã, Eber, Eliel,
verses.en_web: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
verses.en_bbe: And Ishpan and Eber and Eliel

verses.en: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
verses.pt: Abdom, Zicri, Hanã,
verses.en_web: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,
verses.en_bbe: And Abdon and Zichri and Hanan

verses.en: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
verses.pt: Hananias, Elão, Antotias,
verses.en_web: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
verses.en_bbe: And Hananiah and Elam and Anathothijah

verses.en: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
verses.pt: Ifdéias e Penuel foram filhos de Sasaque;
verses.en_web: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,
verses.en_bbe: And Iphdeiah and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

verses.en: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
verses.pt: Sanserai, Searias, Atalias,
verses.en_web: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
verses.en_bbe: And Shamsherai and Shehariah and Athaliah

verses.en: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
verses.pt: Jaaresias, Elias e Zicri foram filhos de Jeroão.
verses.en_web: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.
verses.en_bbe: And Jaareshiah and Elijah and Zichri, the sons of Jeremoth.

verses.en: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Estes foram chefes de casas paternas, segundo as suas gerações, homens principais; e habitaram em Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: These were heads of families in their generations; chief men: these were living in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife’s name was Maachah:
verses.pt: E em Gibeão habitaram o pai de Gibeão, cuja mulher se chamava Maacá,
verses.en_web: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon,
verses.en_bbe: And in Gibeon was living the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife's name was Maacah;

verses.en: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
verses.pt: e seu filho primogênito Abdom, depois Zur, Quiz, Baal, Nadabe,
verses.en_web: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
verses.en_bbe: And his oldest son Abdon, and Zur and Kish and Baal and Ner and Nadab

verses.en: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
verses.pt: Gedor, Aiô, Zequer e Miclote.
verses.en_web: Gedor, Ahio, and Zecher.
verses.en_bbe: And Gedor and Ahio and Zechariah and Mikloth.

verses.en: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
verses.pt: Miclote foi pai de Siméia; também estes habitaram em Jerusalém defronte de seus irmãos.
verses.en_web: Mikloth became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their brothers in Jerusalem, near their brothers.
verses.en_bbe: And Mikloth was the father of Shimeah. And they were living with their brothers in Jerusalem opposite their brothers.

verses.en: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
verses.pt: Ner foi pai de Quis, e Quis de Saul; Saul foi pai de Jônatas, Malquisua, Abinadabe e Es-Baal.
verses.en_web: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.en_bbe: And Ner was the father of Abner, and Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan and Malchi-shua and Abinadab and Eshbaal.

verses.en: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.
verses.pt: Filho de Jônatas foi Meribe-Baal; e Meribe-Baal foi pai de Mica.
verses.en_web: The son of Jonathan was Merib Baal. Merib Baal became the father of Micah.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.

verses.en: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Mica foram: Pitom, Meleque, Tareá e Acaz.
verses.en_web: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Micah: Pithon and Melech and Tarea and Ahaz.

verses.en: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
verses.pt: Acaz foi pai de Jeoada; Jeoada foi pai de Alemete, Azmavete e Zinri; Zinri foi pai de Moza;
verses.en_web: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
verses.en_bbe: And Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri; and Zimri was the father of Moza;

verses.en: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
verses.pt: Moza foi pai de Bineá, de quem foi filho Rafa, de quem foi filho Eleasá, de quem foi filho Azel.
verses.en_web: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
verses.en_bbe: And Moza was the father of Binea: Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son;

verses.en: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.pt: Azel teve seis filhos, cujos nomes foram: Azricão, Bocru, Ismael, Searias, Obadias e Hanã; todos estes foram filhos de Azel.
verses.en_web: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.en_bbe: And Azel had five sons, whose names are: Azrikam, his oldest, and Ishmael and Sheariah and Obadiah and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

verses.en: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Eseque, seu irmão: Ulão, seu primogênito, Jeús o segundo, e Elifelete o terceiro.
verses.en_web: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his oldest son, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

verses.en: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Ulão foram homens heróis, valentes, e flecheiros destros; e tiveram muitos filhos, e filhos de filhos, cento e cinqüenta. Todos estes foram dos filhos de Benjamim.
verses.en_web: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Ulam were men of war, bowmen, and had a great number of sons and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were the sons of Benjamin.
